verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 at https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. A structured API reference page (sonar-post) and the llms.txt docs index also support machine consumption of the API surface. missing for 10: first-party documentation that advertises or describes the spec download, and verification that the spec covers all endpoints (Agent, Search, Embeddings, Router).
